from collections import Counter
def nb(r,c,H,W):
    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: yield rr,cc

def predict(I, tie='nonbg'):
    I=np.array(I);H,W=I.shape;O=I.copy()
    bg=Counter(I.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            cnt=Counter(I[nr,nc] for nr,nc in nb(r,c,H,W))
            own=I[r,c]
            others=[(col,n) for col,n in cnt.items() if col!=own]
            if not others: continue
            best=max(others,key=lambda x:x[1])
            if best[1]>cnt.get(own,0):
                O[r,c]=best[0]
            elif best[1]==cnt.get(own,0):
                if tie=='nonbg' and best[0]!=bg: O[r,c]=best[0]
                elif tie=='keep': pass
    return O
P=predict(I)
print("match nonbg:",(P==O).all())
P2=predict(I,tie='keep')
print("match keep:",(P2==O).all())
d=np.argwhere(P!=O)
for r,c in d: print(r,c,I[r,c],'->',P[r,c],'expected',O[r,c])
